components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width dark sage action for the next truthful studio step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:12px 14px; background:#272e25; border:1px solid #272e25; border-radius:4px; color:#fff; font:500 11px/1.4 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; transition:background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#424d3b; border-color:#424d3b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action for reversible or supporting work.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:42px; padding:10px; background:transparent; border:1px solid #c9cec1; border-radius:4px; color:#3d4936; font:500 11px/1.4 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; transition:background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f0f3e9; border-color:#9faa98; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact neutral control for canvas and navigation actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Add slide"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:30px; height:30px; padding:4px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#6e7069; transition:background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background:#eeeee6; color:#242622; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-icon svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; }

components.name: Story Choice
components.description: A bordered editorial option that becomes sage-washed when chosen.
components.css: .ds-story-choice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; min-height:45px; padding:10px 12px; text-align:left; background:#fdfdf9; border:1px solid #e1e2d8; border-radius:4px; color:#50544b; font:400 11px/1.4 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; transition:background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-story-choice:hover { background:#f3f4ed; } .ds-story-choice:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-choice-number { color:#718165; font:400 17px/1 'StudioDidot', Georgia, serif; } .ds-choice-radio { width:13px; height:13px; margin-left:auto; border:1px solid #c6cbbc; border-radius:50%; }

components.name: Story Text Field
components.description: White, generously padded textarea for creator-authored story copy.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; color:#242622; font:600 11px/1.4 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea { width:100%; min-height:146px; padding:12px; resize:vertical; background:#fff; border:1px solid #dcded2; border-radius:4px; color:#50564a; font:400 11px/1.8 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-field textarea:focus { border-color:#718364; outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: White ruled top bar with Didot wordmark and underlined current route.
components.html: Tiny SohoCarousel Studio
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:36px; height:78px; padding:0 34px; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e2d9; background:#fff; color:#242622; font:500 12px/1.4 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { color:#242622; text-decoration:none; font:400 29px/1 'StudioDidot', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:-1px; } .ds-current { align-self:stretch; display:flex; align-items:center; color:#242622; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:2px solid #242622; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Movement Region
components.description: Bounded, ratio-preserving overlay that marks the editable motion area.
components.html: MOVING AREA
components.css: .ds-region { position:relative; width:55%; height:42%; border:1.5px solid #456d53; background:#91b69a1a; box-shadow:0 0 0 1000px #232d1c0d; color:#fff; } .ds-region > span { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; padding:3px 5px; background:#3f644e; color:#fff; font:400 8px/1 'Avenir Next', Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-region button { position:absolute; right:-8px; bottom:-8px; display:grid; place-items:center; width:23px; height:23px; padding:0; border:1px solid #456d53; border-radius:3px; background:#fffffa; color:#456d53; } .ds-region button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #476853; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-region svg { width:14px; height:14px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; }

narrative.overview:
Tiny Soho Studio treats the creator's finished artwork as the primary material on a quiet, premium worktable. Ivory and white surfaces, near-black controls, fine rules, generous space, and restrained serif display lettering make room for the image to lead. Working controls use plain creator language and a calm system sans so that the interface feels considered without becoming precious.

The desktop workspace is an ordered rail, uncropped source stage, and focused inspector. The rail and inspector provide structure around the artwork; the inspector can scroll while the primary action remains reserved at the bottom. At the 740px breakpoint, the rail becomes a horizontal strip and the inspector follows the image. Source ratio is preserved at every viewport, including the sample preview and movement overlay.
keyCharacteristics: Light editorial surfaces with near-black ink and restrained sage state.
GFS Didot display voice paired with Avenir Next/system sans controls.
Thin dividers, compact four-pixel corners, and quiet tonal depth.
Artwork leads; samples, movement regions, and review states remain explicit.

rules.name: The Rare Sage Rule
rules.body: Use sage as a state signal for active, safe, or editable controls; keep the majority of every screen ivory, white, or ink.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Reserve Didot for naming and hierarchy; use the sans for every action, state, measurement, and explanation.

rules.name: The Flat Worktable Rule
rules.body: Start surfaces flat; use a restrained shadow only where an image, dialog, or active control needs physical separation.

dos: Do let the supplied artwork lead the workspace and preserve its exact source ratio.
Do use Didot for project and inspector naming, and Avenir Next/system sans for operations.
Do use fine rules, warm whites, and restrained sage to clarify state.
Do keep sample labels, review notes, focus rings, and recovery copy visible and truthful.
Do honor the 740px stack and reduced-motion preference; preserve keyboard focus visibility.
donts: Don't crop, stretch, or replace original artwork with a fabricated preview.
Don't introduce dark application chrome, saturated accents, gradients, or decorative glass effects.
Don't imply provider progress, AI analysis, or generation success for the local sample UI.
Don't hide the primary action behind an inspector scroll or make mobile a shrunken desktop grid.
Don't use motion that persists when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active.
